name: Brother HL-L2445DW
model_check: Exact model HL-L2445DW (Europe/Israel/Asia-Pacific). Regional order codes HLL2445DWZU1 (UK), HLL2445DWRE1 (EU). Same body as the HL-L2400DW; the 2445DW adds the wired Ethernet port and prints 2 ppm faster. Not sold in the US (US cousin with the same body: HL-L2460DW, with a fixed power cord).

closed.includes: Paper tray in, output support flap folded, back cover closed. Measured on the photos: the depth runs from the front panel to the small handle tab on the back cover; the flat back panel itself is about 0.9 cm in front of that tab. Cables are not included.

weight_kg.what: with toner and drum (6.0 kg without consumables)

connectivity.details: Hi-Speed USB 2.0 (USB-B), 10/100 Ethernet (RJ45), Wi-Fi 2.4 + 5 GHz (802.11a/b/g/n), Wi-Fi Direct

paper.output_type: top tray, face down (plus 1 sheet face-up through the back cover)
paper.manual_feed: single-sheet slot behind a fold-down cover above the paper tray

toner.note: Codes for Europe and Israel (Bug lists TN2510/TN2510XL for this model). Australia/Asia use TN2530/TN2530XL and DR2530 with the same yields.

in_the_box.items: Printer with the starter toner (about 1,200 pages) already in the DR-2510 drum unit, AC power cord (C13 kettle-type, detachable), Quick Setup Guide, Product Safety Guide, warranty card. No USB or Ethernet cable.
in_the_box.region: Israel (Bug listing; matches Brother UK 'carton contents' and the Quick Setup Guide)
in_the_box.notes: Bug: 'מדפסת | טונר | מחסנית | כבל חשמל | מדריך הפעלה מהירה | גלויית אחריות', USB cable 'לא כלול'.

ils.where: zap.co.il (lowest of 21 shops: Peri Dio, Inkdepo, A.R. Laser Line, Toner Plus)

usd.note: Not a US model, so no US$ listing was found (desertcart.us lists it but showed no price). Brother UK store: £163.92 incl. VAT on 2026-11-17.

power.type: C13 plug into a C14 inlet (mounted upright)
power.position: 1.6 cm from the left edge seen from behind (x = +16.2 cm in the model), 10.8 cm up; the inlet housing stands 0.5 cm proud of the flat back

data.type: Ethernet (RJ45); the USB-B port sits 2 cm below it in the same pocket
data.position: 1.5 cm from the right edge seen from behind (x = -16.35 cm), RJ45 12.5 cm up, USB-B 10.4 cm up, in a 1.1 cm deep corner niche

cable_space.why: The power inlet sits on the flat back strip, so the whole kettle plug and its strain relief stick out behind the printer; the RJ45/USB port pocket is only about 1.1 cm deep, so those plugs stick out too (Ethernet about 2.9 cm behind the body), but less than the power plug (6.5 cm, matches the 3D model).

notes: Same body as the HL-L2400DW. Differences: Ethernet port (the 2400DW has a blank there), 32 instead of 30 pages/min, 1,200-page starter toner instead of 700. Power plug: a straight-on kettle plug on a flat back, so plan about 6-7 cm behind the printer (the user's rule: flat back = 5-8 cm). The back cover folds down to become a 1-sheet face-up tray; it is only needed for thick paper.
